name: WSDL Description
description: Schema describing the top-level description element of a WSDL 2.0 document as defined by the W3C specification. The description is the root element that contains interfaces, bindings, services, and type definitions for a web service.

targetNamespace.description: The namespace URI that identifies the WSDL target namespace for this description.

interface.description: A list of interface definitions describing abstract web service operations.

binding.description: A list of binding definitions specifying concrete message formats and protocols.

service.description: A list of service definitions grouping endpoints for a web service.
